package rulefixtures

import "encoding/json"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_logging_overhead_log_payload_serialized_before_sampling: Layer: Logging overhead. Flag payload serialization for logs before sampling or level filters run.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario561Positive(data interface{}) string {
	// json.Marshal is called eagerly on a potentially large object.
	// If the caller uses sampling (e.g. log 1-in-100), then 99% of
	// this serialization work is wasted. The marshal should happen
	// only after the sampling decision passes.
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(data)
	return string(payload)
}
